generic_domain.justification: Information retrieval (IR) is a broad field that encompasses various aspects of finding, accessing, and managing information. It includes methods for efficiently searching through large datasets to return relevant results. Image retrieval can be considered a subset of IR because it's specifically focused on retrieving images based on certain criteria, such as content or metadata. By choosing 'information retrieval,' we cover all possible retrieve techniques regardless of the data type—text, image, audio, video, etc.—making it the most comprehensive and generic domain in this context.
